title: Group Room Blocks Cut-Off Release Room Nights
content:
The room nights released at the cut-off of a Group Room Blocks rooming-list block are the held room nights less the room nights counted as reserved and less the room nights kept back, and never below zero. The room nights counted as reserved are the nights of the organiser's confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block, and no room nights are kept back.

### Inputs and where they are read

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Held room nights | the block record |
| Room nights counted as reserved | the nights of the organiser's Room Reservations that name the block, are booked at the Group Block Rate and stand confirmed |
| Room nights kept back | none |

### Worked releases (hypothetical rooming-list blocks)

| Held room nights | Nights of confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block | Released |
|---|---|---|
| 240 | 188 | 52 |
| 96 | 96 | 0 |
| 100 | 120 | 0 (never below zero) |
